summary: Enhance your mapping and data analysis skills with our Advanced QGIS training course. Learn to leverage powerful tools for effective geospatial solutions.
lede: An advanced QGIS course helps GIS analysts and spatial data managers turn spatial data into reliable analysis and maps. It addresses the practical work of validating datasets and coordinate systems, carrying out vector and raster analysis, and organizing results for clear communication. Learners also build repeatable workflows with QGIS Processing and Model Designer, and practise producing map layouts and working with GeoPackage or PostGIS.
audienceIntro: Advanced QGIS training suits professionals who already work with spatial data and want stronger analytical, automation, database, or cartographic capability. The course supports intermediate users who need a structured route into advanced workflows and experienced practitioners who want to standardize production methods.
modules: QGIS Project Architecture and Data Quality
Raster Analysis with GDAL and GRASS GIS
OGC Services and Digital GIS Collaboration
prerequisites: You should have working experience with QGIS fundamentals, including loading layers, navigating the map canvas, applying basic symbology, and creating simple layouts. Familiarity with vector and raster data, attribute tables, and coordinate reference systems will help. No programming experience is required for completion. PyQGIS and command-line automation receive conceptual and operational treatment, with optional extension activities for learners who have Python experience. A laptop with QGIS installed is recommended. TrainingCred can provide practice datasets and installation guidance before delivery.
